argv:
import json, os, sys
from pathlib import Path
scoped = Path(sys.argv[1])
print(json.dumps({"local_pid": os.getpid(), "host_proc_self": os.readlink('/proc/self'),
                  "scoped_proc_self": os.readlink(scoped / 'self'),
                  "host_count": sum(x.name.isdecimal() for x in Path('/proc').iterdir()),
                  "scoped_count": sum(x.name.isdecimal() for x in scoped.iterdir()),
                  "effective_ids": [os.geteuid(), os.getegid()], "visible_groups": os.getgroups()}))
